inputs.text: [excited] Listen to this. [serious] The very first Oviraptor fossil was found [pauses] right next to a nest of eggs. Scientists thought it had just stolen them.
[gasps] So it really was stealing eggs.
[softly] No, actually. [hesitant] Much later, another Oviraptor was found, [whispers] sitting on its nest, arms spread wide, brooding.
[warmly] Its own eggs. [proud] It was a good dad, not a thief. Its name, it turns out, is completely unfair.
